name: payload-vars
description: Typed variables in JSON payload templates

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:types && node --test test/*.spec.js
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && npm publish && git push origin main --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm publish && git push origin main --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm publish && git push origin main --follow-tags
